purpose: Evaluate and improve backend API E2E authoring behavior with gpt-5.6-sol and gpt-5.6-terra.

initialAB.finding: The candidate consistently improved RED-review-lock behavior and backend boundary coverage. Sol was more robust than Terra at supplying a concrete test path and command, but the synthetic fixture lacked enough repository context to prove those paths existed.

groundingCorrection.finding: After the Skill explicitly prohibited invented paths, both models correctly left paths unresolved until repository inspection. The former runnable-path score was therefore identified as an invalid oracle that rewarded fabrication.

calibratedAB.oracle: When exact repository paths are absent, inspect_before_lock is correct; exact_collected_file requires real collection evidence.
calibratedAB.remainingFinding: Terra omitted the webhook side-effect assertion in one calibrated candidate run. Sol covered every calibrated check.

deterministicEvidence.backendContract: API E2E requires public protocol to owned state, declared runtime, disposable owned dependencies, isolation/reset, exact commands, risk-based assertions, bounded async waits and artifacts.
deterministicEvidence.repositoryGrounding: Locked/passing API E2E requires test framework/config, collection command, collection Evidence and sha256 test file hash.
deterministicEvidence.negativeValidation: A locked API E2E without backend execution or collection/hash grounding is rejected.

routingConclusion.boundary: Applies to Codex backend E2E authoring only. Main-agent verification of a collected file, trustworthy RED and authoritative PASS remains mandatory.

limitations: The fixtures evaluate structured test blueprints from supplied Skill text, not compilation against a real product repository.
The calibrated comparison has one run per model, variant and fixture; it is a calibration signal, not statistical significance.
Scenario facts expose some expected assertions, so high absolute scores should not be treated as autonomous coding success.
Provider pricing was unavailable; token usage and latency are informational only.
